svg.desc: A configuration dictionary is serialised as canonical JSON with sorted keys, hashed with SHA-256, and the first 12 hex characters become the run id; the run record stores config, metrics, time, code, data and environment versions under that id.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A config that is plain data can be hashed, and the hash names the run.
